content: {"reasoning":"CO-97 is a bundling denial, so missing authorization is irrelevant and the patient owes no contractual share. Although an appeal and peer-to-peer review were previously attempted, the published rules do not establish that further appeal is barred; similar claims favored appeals (2/3 paid) over peer-to-peer review (5/14 paid). Appeal with the strong clinical documentation supporting why this monitoring was medically necessary and separately payable, rather than repeat an unchanged submission.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
